name: Super Administrator
description: Unrestricted administrative authority: create, publish, and delete indicators, configure databases, and delegate user roles.

name: Theme Content Editor
description: Can build, edit, and publish indicators, narratives, and SDG alignments. Cannot delete indicators or manage system users.

name: Data Contributor (RFA / City)
description: Authorized to update quarterly values, time-series, and micro-catchment spatial metrics. Cannot alter indicator definitions or publish new indicators.

name: Auditor & Evaluator
description: Read-only access to review FMES data lineage, system logs, and methodology compliance.
